## Flint __VERSION__

__CHANGELOG__

### Install

See the [install guide](https://0funct0ry.github.io/flint/docs/install/), or:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://0funct0ry.github.io/flint/install.sh | sh
```

| Platform | Asset |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (universal) | `Flint___VERSION___universal.dmg` |
| Linux x86_64 | `.AppImage` and `.deb` |
| Windows x86_64 | `.msi` |

Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.

### No updater — by design

These builds ship **without updater artifacts**. Flint makes no network requests, ever, so there
is no in-app update check. This is intentional, not an oversight. Update through your package
manager (Homebrew, `.deb`) or by downloading a new release.
